definitions.name: ContainsAP
definitions.exact_definition: ∃ a d : Nat, 0 < d ∧ ∀ i : Nat, i < k → A (a + i * d)
definitions.scope: Natural-number positive-step progressions; k=0 is vacuous and k=1 needs only one element. Strict increase for i<j follows from d>0, so k≥2 is nonconstant.

definitions.name: ArbitrarilyLongAPs
definitions.scope: Every natural finite length, including zero. Unbounded available lengths are equivalent by the proved prefix lemma.

selected_theorem_statement_headers.exact_statement_header:
theorem ap_terms_strictly_increase (a d i j : Nat)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hij : i < j) : a + i * d < a + j * d

theorem containsAP_mono {A B : Nat → Prop} {k : Nat}
    (hAB : ∀ n, A n → B n) (hA : ContainsAP A k) : ContainsAP B k

theorem containsAP_prefix {A : Nat → Prop} {k l : Nat}
    (hlk : l ≤ k) (hA : ContainsAP A k) : ContainsAP A l

theorem unbounded_lengths_iff_all_lengths (A : Nat → Prop) :
    (∀ n, ∃ k, n ≤ k ∧ ContainsAP A k) ↔ ArbitrarilyLongAPs A

theorem cofinite_contains_all_lengths {A : Nat → Prop} (N : Nat)
    (hA : ∀ n, N ≤ n → A n) : ArbitrarilyLongAPs A

theorem affine_tail_contains_all_lengths {A : Nat → Prop} (a d N : Nat)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hA : ∀ n, N ≤ n → A (a + n * d)) :
    ArbitrarilyLongAPs A

theorem multiples_contain_all_lengths (d : Nat) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ArbitrarilyLongAPs (fun n => ∃ m, n = m * d)

theorem unbounded_contains_two {A : Nat → Prop}
    (hA : ∀ N : Nat, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ A n) : ContainsAP A 2

theorem powers_two_no_midpoint (i j k : Nat) (hjk : j < k) :
    2 ^ i + 2 ^ k ≠ 2 * 2 ^ j

theorem powers_two_no_three :
    ¬ ContainsAP (fun n => ∃ i : Nat, n = 2 ^ i) 3

theorem powers_two_unbounded :
    ∀ N : Nat, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ (∃ i : Nat, n = 2 ^ i)

theorem unbounded_does_not_imply_all_lengths :
    ¬ (∀ A : Nat → Prop,
      (∀ N : Nat, ∃ n, N ≤ n ∧ A n) → ArbitrarilyLongAPs A)
